svg.text: Fuel sender stand-in on a 2 × 8 cm protoboard (6 × 28 holes), ESP32-CAN-X2
With a 2N7000 stage so the main MOSFET gets 5 V on its gate (the bench IRLB8721 barely switched at 3.3 V). Needs FUEL_PWM_INVERT 1 (the default).
2. Solder side (board flipped left-to-right): grey = solder bridges
Build order (component side, holes as above):
1. Fit the 470 Ω from X06 to X01, the 470 µF at T05 (+) / T03 (−), and the 10 Ω from L04 to P04.
2. Fit the IRLB8721 at K05 / K04 / K03 = Gate / Drain / Source, printed face toward column J, metal tab (= drain) toward column L.
3. Fit the 2N7000 at F02 / G02 / H02 = Source / Gate / Drain, flat face toward row 01.
4. Fit the 100 Ω from C04 to G04, the 10 kΩ from C03 to G03 (keeps the 2N7000 off while the board boots), and the 4.7 kΩ from E06 to I06.
5. Solder the bridges on the solder side, then the wires: B04 → X2 GPIO14 (SV1 7), B01 → an X2 GND pin (SV2 16–18), D06 → X2 5 V (SV2 14/15),
A26 (second A) → cluster pin 2, A21 (second A, row 01) → cluster pin 1. The GND wire goes to the X2 board, not power ground.
• How it works: pin high → 2N7000 on → IRLB8721 gate pulled to 0 V (off). Pin low → 2N7000 off → 4.7 kΩ lifts the gate to 5 V (on). At power-up the needle may head toward F.
• Checks with the power off: G04 to the ground rail ≈ 10 kΩ, I02 to K02 not 0 Ω (the I column must not touch ground), H02 to K05 0 Ω, D06 to K05 ≈ 4.7 kΩ.
• Holes: columns A–Z then A, B (left to right, component side); rows 01–06 from the bottom. Rails: row 06 from P = SENSE, row 01 from B = GROUND. Tested on a 2005 cluster.
